description: Monitoring des capacités d'échanges aux frontières françaises de la région Europe du Sud-Ouest en 2020 is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). « Monitoring Paquet Energie Propre 70% » Le règlement européen de l’électricité, dans le cadre du Paquet Energie Propre adopté en 2019, exige des GRT d’être en mesure de monitorer la capacité du réseau devant être mis à disposition des échanges transfrontaliers en introduisant une cible ambitieuse de 70%. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Marchés. Its keywords are Interconnexion, Calcul de capacité, CEP. The portal shows 2021-04-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
